prompt_head:
Role: Solutions Architect at Smartsheet
<requirements>
[r1] (required, years_experience) 3 years relevant work experience or equivalent combination of relevant

assessments.note: About 4 years of professional experience meets the 3-year requirement; mentoring shown.
Working skills in both Python and Node.js are shown.
Shipped full-stack apps on React, Cloudflare Workers, and Hono.
LLM evaluation and LLM API-driven pipelines are shown.
Built a LangGraph tool-using agent with prompt engineering.
Claude Code orchestrator and sub-agent workflows are shown.
Enterprise client integration blueprints are adjacent but not explicit SaaS/IPaaS work.
Systems architect roles designing platforms and integrations; scale evidence is limited.
Data validation pipelines shown; large data volume practices not evidenced.
ETL and CRM work shown; business analytics and reporting integration not evidenced.
Sales development and client-facing success roles are shown.
Onboarding and mentoring shown; presentation to non-technical users not explicit.
Founder and lead roles delivered projects end to end; project management certification held.
No evidence of travel experience or willingness to travel.
Information Technology bachelor's is in progress, not completed; closely adjacent to MIS/CIS/CS.

output.verdict_line: The candidate meets most technical requirements, with gaps in enterprise SaaS/IPaaS exposure, large data volume practices, and travel willingness.
top_gaps: Experience with SaaS/IPaaS applications in an enterprise environment
Large data volume design best practices
